manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0103; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: One person is waiting and Yes, one person are plausible short answers in the queue context.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently uses «نفر» for the selected person sense.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Two people are waiting is a same-domain contrast rather than random noise.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner responses are short and controlled for A1.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second exchange shifts from a full statement to confirming the count.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, queue scenario, turns and activities share one bounded sense.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review covers only the bounded A1 target sense of person.
Generated audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
